title: Sleeper Beyond — first claw-like draft
prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Landscape 3:2 environment/creature revelation concept sheet for Depths. Supplied sheet is style/layout reference ONLY: retain serious gritty painting, broad shadow masses, dirty ivory and charcoal mineral material. This is the deepest proposed presence, NOT a confirmed final boss or the relic.
THE SLEEPER BEYOND. A mine cavern ends at an impossibly VERTICAL SHEET OF DARK WATER, rising like a still liquid wall from floor to unseen roof, with a clear rippling skin and a few pale upward-moving condensation beads. Through it at enormous distance lies a white jointed form that initially looks like ruined ancient architecture: immense rounded bent spans, a long curved surface, broad steps/ridges. The REVELATION is that the ENTIRE white structure is ONLY ONE ENORMOUS CURLED FINGER, its three bent phalanges and dirty crescent nail giving it away. One single finger only. DO NOT show a hand, palm, other fingers, head, eye, face, whole body, throne or temple idol. Its base vanishes into unlit distance; the body and identity remain unknowable. Weathered ivory skin, fold-lines at huge joints, a slightly fleshy mineral weight, not an actual skeleton bone hand.
MAIN left two-thirds: composed wide cavern view from tiny human/mining scale. Two very small cloaked expedition silhouettes with one dim lantern stand near broken wooden mine rails in the foreground, looking at the vertical dark-water barrier. Beyond it the giant curled finger spans the distant void like a structure; human/mining scale cues are tiny but readable. Main mass must first suggest architecture and then reveal the bent finger through knuckles and broad nail. No text explaining the trick. Light is low cold reflected water with a little amber foreground lantern; avoid luminous blue magic, glitter, stars or bright epic-fantasy lighting.
UPPER RIGHT contextual inset: slightly clearer side outline of the SAME single curled finger behind the same upright water plane, position shifted minimally once as a quiet suggested joint movement, not another limb or full creature. LOWER RIGHT omen: close-up of DRY rough mine rock with condensation beads elongated upward toward a dark crack, no open ocean or actual surf illustration. Bottom narrow band: very small dark shape study of the architectural/finger silhouette against dull grey with one tiny mining support for scale.
Dark gritty grotesque cosmic horror through incomprehensible scale and living material. Restrained detail and physical weight, unresolved presence. NO letters, arrows, labels, symbols, HUD, health bars, ornate border, skeletal giant hand or extra monster. This is a concept painting and environmental reveal; no combat sprite or gameplay commitment.
review_status: Superseded candidate; claw shape refined to a blunt single finger in the current draft
